C0738.title: Chongqing Tax Official Sentenced for Taking Bribes in Export Tax Refund Matters
C0738.summary: In July 2023, the State Taxation Administration reported that Quan, an official of a district tax bureau in Chongqing, used his positions as former head of the district state tax bureau and deputy head of the district tax bureau to help enterprises with export tax refund declarations and repeatedly accepted property from related parties. Quan was expelled from the Party and dismissed from public office, and was sentenced to two years in prison for bribery.
